title: Frontend's animal identification page does not show what the consignment holds; Design release 1 lists the commodities with their animal counts and a way to change or add to them

finding.frontend: Between the inset text and the first commodity card there is nothing. The page goes straight from "You must add all animal identification details before the consignment arrives at the port of entry" into the identifier forms (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.njk:11-23). What the consignment holds is readable only by scrolling the forms themselves: each card is headed "Cow (0102) — Bos taurus" and carries a counter reading "Enter details for Bos taurus 1 of 2", so the code and the count are on the page but scattered through it, the common name is nowhere, and there is no link back to the commodity list. The one "Add a commodity" link in the template is in the branch that runs when the notification has no commodities at all (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.njk:27-32), so it disappears at the moment the page becomes usable. Frontend does build a Selected commodities table — commodity code, common name and a Remove per row — but only on the consignment details page, at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/consignment-details/_selected-commodities-table.njk, and it carries no animal count.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 opens the page with a "Selected commodities" summary: a header row of Commodity code, Common name and Number of animals, a row per commodity showing all three, a "Change" link on each row back to the commodity search, and an "Add another commodity" link under the table (app/views/animal-identification-details.html:55-83). A trader entering identifiers can see at a glance that they owe two Bos taurus records, and can correct the commodity list without hunting for the page that owns it.
finding.difference: Add a Selected commodities summary above the identification cards, showing commodity code, common name and number of animals per line, with a Change link per row to the commodity search and an Add another commodity link beneath. Frontend already renders a version of this table on consignment details, so the work is to reuse it and add the animal count column: the view model that feeds it is src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/consignment-details/view-model/groups.js and the number of animals is already on the line. The row action changes too — the consignment details table's action is Remove, and the summary on this page needs a Change link to the commodity search. The "Add a commodity" link should also stop being conditional on there being nothing to show.
finding.falsifiedBy: A per-commodity summary rendered above the identification cards on Frontend's page — a table, a list or a set of rows pairing each commodity with its animal count — or any link on that page to the commodity search. The captured DOM of fe-animal-identification has nothing between the inset text at :119-121 and the first card at :129, and every href it carries goes to the dashboard, the hub or sign-out.
finding.verification: Ran the falsifier by reading capture/html/frontend/fe-animal-identification.html whole and listing every href on it: nothing sits between the inset and the first card, and no link reaches the commodity search. Read the frontend template whole and confirmed the empty-state branch at :27-32 holds the only "Add a commodity" link. Read capture/html/prototype/dr1-animal-identification-details.html:268-295 for the summary and checked the Change href is /what-are-you-importing?resetSearch=1 and the Add another commodity href /what-are-you-importing. Read the frontend's consignment-details table macro whole. Opened both page shots side by side. The finding stands; two claims in it were false and are corrected below.
finding.correction: The finding stands — Design release 1 opens the page with a Selected commodities summary and Frontend opens it with nothing — but the frontend slot overstated what a trader cannot see, and the falsifier repeated the overstatement. Both are fixed. It said a trader "cannot see how many animals each commodity is supposed to have" and "cannot see the commodity codes"; the captured page shows both. The commodity code is in every card heading ("Cow (0102) — Bos taurus", capture/html/frontend/fe-animal-identification.html:130) and the count is in every counter ("Enter details for Bos taurus 1 of 2", :133). What is genuinely absent is the at-a-glance summary itself, the common name, the Change link to the commodity search and the Add another commodity link, and the slot now says that instead. The falsifier was rewritten for the same reason: as first written it fired on the card headings and would have read as falsifying a finding that is true. One further correction to the difference slot: it called the consignment-details table "this exact summary", and it is not — that table has no Number of animals column and its row action is Remove rather than Change (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/consignment-details/_selected-commodities-table.njk:10-25), so reusing it is more than a lift.
